title: PH60301: Nuclear Many Body Physics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Symmetries and group theory in nuclear physics. Models of nuclear structure :
nuclear matter, surface deformations and vibrations. Rotating nuclei. More
general collective motion. Interacting boson models. Giant Resonances.
Microscopic models : independent particles model. N-N interaction. Effective
interactions. Spherical shell model. Deformed shell model. Variational models.
Relativistic Mean Field approach. Interplay of single particle and collective
motion.
